programs.title: Salvage Hunters
programs.desc: Drew accepts a private invitation to one of the grandest stately homes in the country, Palace House. He is stunned by a large collection of electric light fittings.

programs.title: Tanked
programs.desc: Take a look back at the tanks ATM have built that were inspired by moments in history, including a 1920s mob-themed tank and a 1960s lava lamp tank.

programs.title: Wheeler Dealers World Tour
programs.desc: The Fiat 500 originated out of the Fiat 600, a car that was massive on the continent, but little seen elsewhere. Mike's found one that has been imported recently, and there is plenty for Elvis to do.

programs.title: Kindig Customs
programs.desc: Dave's latest client wants him to outlaw a Porsche 356 A, which means a ton of modifications, including smoothed-out bumpers and a louvered deck lid.

programs.title: Ice Road Truckers
programs.desc: In the season's dramatic finale, Lisa and Todd struggle to complete their daring joint venture across the frozen Hudson Bay. Darrell braves the most torn up trail remaining on the winter roads. Art must face the last open ice crossing--and his first since his near fatal trip weeks earlier. And deep in the thawing wilderness, a tanker sideswipes Alex.

programs.title: Motorway Cops USA
programs.desc: In the middle of New Jersey's car theft epidemic, Patrolmen Maurice Marsilla and Bill Gibson pull over a suspicious Lamborghini that is 1000 miles from home. Discovering the driver is a wanted man the officers need him out of the vehicle.
